facts.business: Variman Global Enterprises Limited is engaged in the trading of electronic products including laptops and other electronic items, as well as FMCG products, and provides software and other services.
key_risks: Inventory valuation and existence risk due to high volume of SKUs, frequent purchases and sales, varying product margins, price fluctuations, and risks relating to obsolescence, damage and slow-moving items
Liquidity risk from inability to meet financial obligations
Market risk including currency risk and other price risks
facts.related_party_note: During the year under review, the Company had not entered into any materially significant transaction with any related party. All related party transactions during the year are in the ordinary course of business and on arm's length basis.
